admin-survey.audience.participant.description: Row name in the questionnaire screen's audience table.

admin-survey.audience.volunteer.description: Row name in the questionnaire screen's audience table.

admin-survey.column.audience.description: Column heading in the questionnaire screen's audience table.

admin-survey.column.download.description: Column heading for each audience's download link.

admin-survey.column.responses.description: Column heading for how many answers each audience has sent.

admin-survey.column.switch.description: Column heading for each audience's switch in the server configuration. `.env` is the file's name and stays as is.

admin-survey.download.description: Link that downloads one audience's answers as a CSV file.

admin-survey.intro.description: Line under the questionnaire screen's heading.

admin-survey.noQuestions.description: Shown in place of the download when an audience has no questions file and no answers.

admin-survey.override.automatic.description: Override choice that hands the questionnaire back to the configured schedule.

admin-survey.override.closed.description: Override choice that closes the questionnaire for both audiences, whatever the schedule says.

admin-survey.override.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível salvar. Tente novamente.
admin-survey.override.failed.description: Error when saving the override fails for any reason not otherwise named.

admin-survey.override.forbidden.defaultMessage: Seu login não tem permissões para abrir ou fechar o feedback.
admin-survey.override.forbidden.description: Error when an administrator without the survey:write permission tries to save the override.

admin-survey.override.hint.defaultMessage: Definir a disponibilidade do formulário de feedback, sobrescrevendo os horários de abertura e fechamento definido nas configurações do servidor.
admin-survey.override.hint.description: Explains the override's reach under its heading. `.env` is the file's name and stays as is.

admin-survey.override.open.description: Override choice that opens the questionnaire for both audiences, whatever the schedule says.

admin-survey.override.save.description: Button that saves the override choice.

admin-survey.override.saved.description: Toast on the reloaded screen once the override is saved.

admin-survey.reason.disabled.defaultMessage: Nenhum público está ativado nas configurações do servidor.
admin-survey.reason.disabled.description: Why the questionnaire is closed: both audiences are switched off in the server configuration.

admin-survey.reason.override.description: Why the questionnaire is open or closed: an administrator forced it.

admin-survey.reason.schedule.description: Why the questionnaire is open or closed: the configured schedule decides.

admin-survey.responses.description: How many answers an audience has sent.

admin-survey.schedule.closes.description: When the schedule closes the questionnaire. {at} is a date and time in the event's time zone.

admin-survey.schedule.noClose.defaultMessage: Horário de fechamento não definido: o feedback continuará aberto.
admin-survey.schedule.noClose.description: Shown when the schedule sets no closing time.

admin-survey.schedule.opens.description: When the schedule opens the questionnaire. {at} is a date and time in the event's time zone.

admin-survey.switch.off.description: An audience whose questionnaire is switched off in the server configuration.

admin-survey.switch.on.description: An audience whose questionnaire is switched on in the server configuration.

admin-survey.volunteerNote.description: Warning beside the volunteer answers. Volunteers are few and known by name, so their anonymous answers are far easier to re-identify than a participant's.
